module: Editor API for creating, modifying and deleting roads (DecalRoad) and node-based meshes such as rivers (River, via createMesh). It also keeps a local list of the level's roads (allRoads) and, if the roadTemplates.general.loadTemplates preference is enabled, their midpoints (roadSplines). initialize(editor) adds all these functions to the editor object. Each modification calls editor.setDirty().
usage:
local id = editor.createRoad({{pos = vec3(0,0,0), width = 4}, {pos = vec3(20,0,0), width = 4}}, {overObjects = true})
editor.addRoadNode(id, {pos = vec3(40,5,0), width = 4, index = 2})
notes: addRoadNode reads nodeInfo.pos while its doc comment says "position": the actual key is pos (width and index too).
createRoad reads roadInfo.overObjects before testing roadInfo: crashes if roadInfo is nil and a terrain exists.
In deleteRoad, the loop over decorationIDs does not check that scenetree.findObjectById returns an object (decoration already deleted: possible error).
updateRoadVertices and removeRoadFromList (local) are not all exposed: only updateRoadVertices is.

initialize.desc: Registers all the module's functions on the editor object. Called when the editor API is loaded.

editor.desc: Functions added to the editor object by initialize.

updateRoadVertices.desc: Registers the road in allRoads and, if road templates are enabled, remembers the midpoint positions of its edges (roadSplines). Logs an error if road is nil.

resetRoadList.desc: Empties the local lists allRoads and roadSplines.

addRoadNode.desc: Inserts a node into a road and updates its vertices.

nodeInfo.desc: {pos = vec3, width = number, index = integer}; index U32_MAX to insert at the end.

returns.desc: Id of the new node (value returned by insertNode).

setNodeWidth.desc: Changes the width of a road or mesh node.

setNodeDepth.desc: Changes the depth of a node (river-type meshes).

createRoad.desc: Creates a DecalRoad (improvedSpline, BlankWhite material), registers it, applies roadInfo via editor.pasteFields, adds it to MissionGroup then adds the nodes. Without a terrain in the level, overObjects is forced to true.

roadInfo.desc: Fields to apply to the road (e.g. overObjects).

deleteRoad.desc: Deletes a road, recursively its child roads (childRoads field) and its decorations (decorationIDs), removes it from the lists and marks the editor as modified.

deleteRoadNode.desc: Deletes a road node and updates its vertices.

getNodes.desc: Reads all the nodes of an object: pos, width, and depth/normal if the object provides getNodeDepth/getNodeNormal.

addMeshNode.desc: Inserts a node into a mesh (river, etc.).

deleteMeshNode.desc: Deletes a node from a mesh.

createMesh.desc: Creates a node-based mesh of the given type. For 'River', sets default values (waves, speeds, base color 45 108 171 255, water textures). Applies fields via editor.pasteFields, registers it under a unique name "New<type>", adds it to MissionGroup, positions the object on the first node and adds the nodes.

getAllRoads.desc: Returns the table of known roads (key = id, value true).

getAllSplines.desc: Returns the midpoints remembered per road (only filled if roadTemplates.general.loadTemplates is enabled).

initializeLevelRoadsVertices.desc: Resets the lists then walks all the level's DecalRoads to register them. Logs an error for an invalid name (starting with digits).

regenerateAllDecalRoads.desc: Calls regenerate() on all known roads.
